_comment: spa_routes = SPA-owned page routes. Despite the name, is_spa_route (scripts/gen_routes.py) matches EXACT-OR-SUBTREE, not exact-only: '/calls' owns '/calls/1' and '/b' owns '/b/<slug>' the same way, via `path == r or path.startswith(r.rstrip('/') + '/')`. This description predates that subtree behaviour and is now wrong about the very function it describes; trust scripts/gen_routes.py, not this sentence (PLAN-DEFECTS.md D19 item 8). /login, /register and the three /auth/* holding pages are React (auth slice). Bare /auth is NOT an spa_route: it would make is_spa_route('/auth/google/start') True and let the dev Vite proxy shadow the real OAuth endpoints (dev-proxy.ts keys off isSpaRoute with no backend-precedence check); the three explicit leaves avoid that. /auth stays in backend_prefixes (doc-only) because POST /auth/google/start + GET /auth/google/callback live there. backend_prefixes / is_backend_route are NOT consulted by the serving or proxy path.
